description: A single graded evidence item drawn from a whitelisted source (G1). Carries verifiable provenance (PMID / DOI / Cochrane CD-ID / guideline-ID), study type, GRADE evidence grade (G2), the condition + treatment it pertains to, and a neutral summary. NOT patient-specific (corpus-level, no PHI). Per ADR-2606072800 §Decision 5 (suimin_source_ingest / suimin_evidence_grade).

sourceClass.description: MUST be present in the active com.etzhayyim.suimin.sourceWhitelist (G1).

provenanceId.description: Verifiable identifier (e.g., PMID 23589584 / DOI 10.xxxx / Cochrane CD001106 / AASM-GL-OSA-2019). Required (G1).

canonicalUrl.description: Stable resolver URL (e.g., https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/<pmid>/). Display/audit only — not a vendored copy.

treatmentSlug.description: Stable treatment-modality slug, e.g., cpap / oral-appliance-mad / positional-therapy / weight-loss-lifestyle / upper-airway-surgery / hypoglossal-nerve-stimulation / adaptive-servo-ventilation.

evidenceGrade.description: GRADE assessment (G2). Bounded by the sourceClass maxDefaultGrade. preprint -> low (G12).

gradeRationale.description: Brief GRADE downgrade/upgrade reasoning (risk of bias / inconsistency / indirectness / imprecision).

summary.description: Neutral, brand-free summary of the finding (device class / INN only — G12). No individual recommendation (G4).

conflictOfInterestFlag.description: true if author/funding COI detected (e.g., device-manufacturer funded). Surfaced; vendor-marketing sources excluded entirely (G12).
